key_highlights: ASX pressured by Wall Street correction contagion, partially cushioned by mining sector resilience.
Australian Flash PMI plunged into recession territory, signalling accelerating domestic macro slowdown.
Extreme short positions on the Australian dollar (AUD) heighten currency volatility and imported price pressures.
Ongoing Chinese property market contraction clouds medium-term iron ore demand outlook.
Cumulative RBA rate hikes strain mortgage serviceability and household borrowing power.

sectors.trend: Miners rebounding amid active gold exploration and government copper funding despite Chinese property headwinds.
sectors.implications: Short-term support for BHP.AX and RIO.AX; gold explorers and producers offer defensive appreciation.

sectors.trend: Mortgage serviceability constraints and rising household stress test bank asset quality and credit growth.
sectors.implications: Margin pressure and slowing credit growth for major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX); scrutiny on APRA buffers.

sectors.trend: Persistent domestic gas supply shortages compounded by surging energy requirements from data centres.
sectors.implications: Favourable pricing power for domestic gas producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX), though elevated input costs hit heavy industry.

sectors.trend: Discretionary retail under stress from mortgage pain while staples face compliance and supply chain costs.
sectors.implications: Earnings downgrade risks for discretionary retail; margin headwinds for WOW.AX following wage underpayment remediation.

sectors.trend: Valuations face headwinds from Wall Street tech sell-offs and shifting enterprise dynamics around AI adoption.
sectors.implications: High-beta ASX tech (^AXTJ) exposed to global risk-off rotation and multiples contraction.

key_themes: Global equity market contagion following Wall Street entering correction territory.
Domestic macro contraction as Flash PMI signals contractionary economic conditions.
Severe speculative AUD shorting amplifying foreign exchange vulnerability.
China property downturn challenging bulk commodity export resilience.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate out of cyclical discretionary into defensive healthcare (CSL.AX) and cash equivalents.
Implement index-level hedging on ^AXJO and reduce high-multiple growth equity holdings.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China Real Estate Slump & Commodity Softness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify resource exposure toward gold and critical minerals over pure-play iron ore (FMG.AX).
Underweight major retail banks with elevated exposure to heavily geared residential books.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold producers and exploration assets
opportunities.rationale: Strong domestic discovery pipeline and safe-haven demand buffer against broader market corrections and AUD weakness.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to critical minerals and government-backed copper plays
opportunities.rationale: Strategic funding and resource expansion insulate against cyclical bulk commodity downturns.

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain allocations to cash-generative domestic energy producers
opportunities.rationale: Structural gas shortages in eastern Australia underpin robust domestic realised prices.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge downside risk on benchmark equities
defensive_moves.rationale: Heightened equity volatility and negative Flash PMI trends increase near-term drawdown risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-multiple discretionary retailers and rate-sensitive retail REITs
defensive_moves.rationale: Exhaustion of consumer borrowing power and structural department store challenges threaten earnings.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to retail banking majors
defensive_moves.rationale: High serviceability buffers and cumulative rate hikes constrain credit growth and increase arrears.

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious and volatile 1–3 month outlook for the ASX 200 (^AXJO) amid US market correction contagion, PMI weakness, and extreme AUD shorts.
market_outlook.long_term: Bifurcated 6–12 month outlook balancing domestic monetary easing prospects against ongoing Chinese real estate structural headwinds.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy statements and cash rate expectations
Australian quarterly GDP and CPI inflation prints
APRA review of mortgage serviceability buffer settings
China policy responses to property sector contraction
US equity market stabilization and Federal Reserve guidance
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate and speculative positioning
Benchmark iron ore prices (62% Fe CFR China)
Australian Flash Manufacturing and Services PMIs
Bank mortgage arrears and consumer spending trends
